correctness.rationale: Orthogonal diagonalization of real symmetric negative-semidefinite factors reduces every spectral error to Cov(e^-aU,e^-bU) for U uniform on [0,1]. The symmetric double-integral gives nonnegative sign and zero exactly when a=0 or b=0. Cauchy–Schwarz bounds F(a,b) by max_t Var(e^-tU), attained only a=b=t*. Symbolic derivative 2t^3 W'(t)=e^-2t H(t) and sign-chain H triple-prime = -4e^t J(t) with J double-prime = (2t-1)e^t shows a single positive maximizing root; independent derivative and covariance checks give t*=3.24530448 and C*=0.0661398939754. Rank and dimension arbitrary but factors symmetric. Relative captured action tends zero for a=b→∞; fixed generators have h²/12 A⊗B leading error. Analytic argument, not grid, proves sharp global norm statement.
residual_risks: Finite experiments and exact checks do not alone establish infinite/uniform quantifiers; proof reconstructed from original RESULT.md.
